experiment: Fine-tuned preview encoder for partly filled chunks on the public 20M streaming Zipformer

finetune.trainable: copy of the encoder and encoder projection; decoder, joiner and the native encoder stay frozen
finetune.loss: KL(frozen full-chunk joiner distribution || preview joiner distribution) on the frozen greedy path, 8 frames per chunk

stage2.note: the 800 gate-training utterances are excluded from fine-tuning

scope: Declared before the run. The native pass and the final output are those of the unmodified 20M model. Preview passes read native state and never write it. `ft` previews run in PyTorch and are charged the measured ONNX time of the zero-fill preview of the same chunk, because the graph and input shape are identical. Preview points: k=7 is the moment the previous chunk's native pass becomes possible (39-frame window, 32-frame hop).
